name: Toll
author: E. T. Carter
description: A great bronze drumhead seen dead-on: a circular disc nearly fills the frame, its rim a hairline of edge light. Its vibration is an analytic sum of concentric radial partials with a faint diametral rider; fixed nodal circles stay dark while annular antinode zones tremble with glow, hue keyed by radius across the palette. A hash-scheduled strike floods the modes and they ring down exponentially — the quartered shimmer melts into breathing rings, then the slow fundamental, then a faint residual figure.

params.label: Strike gap
params.effect: Mean seconds between hash-scheduled strikes, from a busy bell to long contemplative silences over the residual figure.

params.label: Ring time
params.effect: Exponential decay constant of the ring-down, from a damped thud to a long singing sustain.

params.label: Mode richness
params.effect: Continuously fades the upper partials in, from a single breathing fundamental ring to the full quartered figure.
